items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: That's the drummer, Claiborne Williams. He married Claiborne Williams' daughter.

ctx.x: Did he ever play with the Claiborne Williams band? Yeah. That's the best with his drummer. Oh, it was his drummer.
That's the drummer, Claiborne Williams. He married Claiborne Williams' daughter.
You never knew him by any other name? Never knew him by any other name.
